changelog: Reduce ClawScan surface by making the skill no-code: remove bundled helper scripts, credential writer, endpoint override, and MCP client while retaining approval-first Buffer workflow guidance.
summary:
Safely draft, review, inspect, and explicitly approved schedule/publish workflows through Buffer's official MCP server. Use when an operator has already configured Buffer MCP in their MCP client or OpenClaw runtime and wants approval-first social media workflow guidance for Buffer accounts, organizations, channels/profiles, drafts, queues, scheduled posts, or publishing.

NOTE: Buffer rate limits the amount of API calls and OpenClaw can burn them fast. https://buffer.com/pricing#compare-plans
